item.title: How to Win the Battle Against AI, Jennifer Lopez’s OUTRAGEOUS Grievance on Display, and More | Ep. 1448 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Nate Soares, president of the Machine Intelligence Research Institute, to discuss the rapid growth of artificial intelligence, the difference between OpenAI and ClosedAI, its potential to replace human jobs, the risks it could pose to humanity, the need to prevent the rapid development of superintelligence, how AI is already outperforming human capabilities, alarming projections about artificial intelligence, whether a kill switch could stop a dangerous AI system, why developers need to be careful as the technology advances, recent technology outages and what they revealed about society’s growing dependence on AI, Sam Altman’s response to the debate surrounding artificial intelligence, and more. Plus, Megyn Kelly discusses Russell Brand's wife resuming their YouTube show, how her decision to air a 90 second clip of Russell Brand became a "big issue" during his trial, Jennifer Lopez’s recent comments about her life and career as she plays the race card, her grievance on display despite her wealth and success, receipts on her successful film and music career, how Thomas Markle Sr.'s allegations were an "open secret" in the family, Meghan Markle claiming she didn't know about her father's allegations, viral clip of Prince Harry taking a shot of whiskey, the latest on Ilhan Omar, and more.
